no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not presented to an Advisory Committee because the product is a member of the class of GBCA and did not present unique safety concerns nor difficulty in interpretation of the data from the image reread.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for ABLAVAR (NDA021711). The Summary Review states the application was not presented to an Advisory Committee because the product is a gadolinium-based contrast agent (GBCA) class member that did not present unique safety concerns or difficulty interpreting the image reread data; the medical review likewise notes no advisory committee meeting was planned. With no AdComm held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
